mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user) AS users, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user WHERE created_at >= #{since}) AS new_users7d, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item) AS items

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM tb_ai_analysis_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}

SELECT provider AS provider_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, round(avg(latency_ms))::BIGINT AS avg_latency_ms, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens FROM tb_ai_analysis_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY provider ORDER BY provider

where.if: AND (u.email ILIKE #{f.qPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR u.name ILIKE #{f.qPattern} ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.status, u.created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i WHERE i.user_id = u.user_id) AS item_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l WHERE l.user_id = u.user_id AND l.feature = 'ITEM_ANALYZE' AND l.status = 'SUCCESS' AND l.created_at >= #{todayFrom} AND l.created_at < #{todayTo}) AS ai_today FROM tb_user u
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.ai_analysis_log_id, l.created_at, l.user_id, u.email AS user_email, l.feature, l.provider, l.model, l.status, l.latency_ms, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.image_bytes, l.image_sha256, l.error_code, l.result FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.ai_analysis_log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id

SELECT l.ai_analysis_log_id, l.created_at, l.user_id, u.email AS user_email, l.feature, l.provider, l.model, l.status, l.latency_ms, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.image_bytes, l.image_sha256, l.error_code, l.result FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.ai_analysis_log_id = #{id}

SELECT count(*) FROM tb_admin_audit_log a
a.target_type = #{targetType}
